title: Mushroom House Gathering
description: A large yellow robot and a golden retriever sit on the wooden porch of a giant green mushroom house with hanging wind chimes and a clock. Below, three girls in yellow dresses hold candles while dancing in a glowing spiral pattern on the ground, as a translucent green ghost holding a candle stands on a rocky outcrop to the right emitting colorful magical particles.
prompt: A giant green mushroom with white spots serves as a house with a wooden porch, where a yellow boxy robot with a sad face and a happy golden retriever are sitting together. Blue wind chimes and a clock hang from the mushroom cap. In the foreground, three young girls in bright yellow dresses hold lit candles while dancing in a swirling blue-green glowing spiral on the grass. To the right, a translucent green ghost holding a candle emits colorful sparkles and musical notes float in the air. Fantasy landscape with mountains and trees in the background.
